h: 该工作流程集成了Flux.1 Kontext Pro+Max+文本转图像+图像转图像+提示词串联输出等优化工作流程。它可以用作基本的 Kontext 工作流程。使用前需要购买ComfyUI官方API Key

o.en: This workflow integrates Flux.1 Kontext Pro+Max+text-to-image+image-to-image+prompt word tandem output and other optimized workflows. It can be used as a basic Kontext workflow. Before use, you need to purchase the ComfyUI official API Key
